maria: Quick check — where are we on token-cost attribution and latency breakdown handoff? Need owners and blockers for the next milestone (schema freeze end of week). @alex @sam

alex: I own the event schema. PR #458 is open but blocked by billing review; need a sample join key from billing to validate joins. :hourglass:

sam: I'm owning telemetry ingest + KV tagging. Can run canary once schema merged. PR I opened: https://git.internal/rw/pr/462 — smoke tests passing locally.

jess: Frontend needs the new `token_bucket_id` field added to embeddings events — otherwise the UI cost panel will be misattributing. I'll approve the schema PR after alex adds an example payload with that field.

alex: Will add the example payload in a minute. Quick example we want in the event docs:
```
{"event_type":"embedding","token_bucket_id":"proj-123","tokens":12,"latency_ms":34}
```

devops-bot: deploy scheduled: canary pipeline to staging at 2026-04-12T18:00Z if PRs are merged. :white_check_mark:

sre-oncall: FYI latency alert threshold for `inference-proxy` is 350ms — if the canary shows >20% regress we auto-rollback. Please surface perf numbers in the canary report.

maria: Blockers: billing needs a sample join key from analytics team. @anthony — can you share the sample today?

anthony: (billing-team) I'll drop the sample in #data-delivery by EOD and ping here. :thumbsup:

maria: Plan recap: alex finish schema examples today; sam run canary tomorrow; jess verify UI mapping; anthony provide sample. Target: schema freeze Fri EOD. Ping me if anything slips. :eyes:
